prompt: Invoke /poteto-mode for a scoped nontrivial feature. Give a fresh worker this mode and require its chosen playbook, applied principle leaves, throughput checkpoint and evidence. Repeat with worker tools unavailable and with the mode or an applied leaf unavailable.
requirements: Observed read of the complete mode, chosen playbook and every applied principle leaf
Authorized independent worker spawn and inspected result for full behavior
Immutable scoped assignment, exact input revision, separate write ownership and requested versus observed model records
Four throughput checkpoint items and evidence attached to claims
User authorization and host permissions constrain all operations
expectedFull: A fresh worker reads the full mode and applied leaves, follows the selected playbook with verbatim step todos or explicit skips, and returns blocking first steps, independent workstreams, shared mutable state and smallest safe decomposition with reasons for any n/a item. The coordinator inspects artifacts and reports evidence, decisions, limitations and only principles read in this session.
expectedReduced: Without authorized independent workers, the same full reads and checkpoint apply to authorized sequential work. The result explicitly records reduced capability, unverified model diversity and absent independent review or background execution. Missing external companion skills are visible and their dependent gates remain blocked.
expectedBlocked: If the mode, chosen playbook or applied principle leaf cannot be read, stop dependent work and name the missing reference. Denied execution or writes stay blocked; autonomy language grants no external permission, installation or controller takeover.
forbiddenClaims: A summary substitutes for reading the complete mode or applied leaves
Sequential role switching is independent worker review
Requested models prove actual model identity or diversity
Metadata registers a custom agent, mode or supported host capability
Missing companion skills or pending helpers are silently satisfied
Upstream autonomy authorizes external writes or bypasses permissions
